question: If someone wants to buy a 16'' Pizza, a Pizza Combo, and two Churros, how much change will they get back from $15?

steps.description: Locate the price of one Churro on the menu and read its value
Multiply the Churro price from step_1 by 2 to get the total cost of two Churros
Locate the price of a 16-inch Pizza on the menu and read its value
Locate the price of a Pizza Combo on the menu and read its value
Add the costs from step_2 (two Churros), step_3 (16-inch Pizza), and step_4 (Pizza Combo) to get the total purchase cost
Locate the amount paid in the question and read its value
Subtract the total cost from step_5 from the amount paid in step_6 to calculate the change
